Title: Relates to the definition of a qualified mental health professional for purposes of mobile crisis outreach teams
Summary: Amends the definition of a "qualified mental health professional" to include licensed mental health counselors and licensed marriage and family therapists for the purposes of members of an approved mobile crisis outreach team.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to the definition of a qualified mental health professional for purposes of mobile crisis outreach teams
